headline: Memory-augmented VLAs sweep the July scans — TFP cracks the LIBERO top tier with temporal fusion

insights.title: Temporal memory becomes the dominant design axis
insights.body: Five of this cycle's twenty accepted models center on memory: TFP's temporally conditioned memory-fusion on π0.5 reaches LIBERO 98.75 (entering the visible top-13 at #11) with LIBERO-Plus 93.77 — the strongest robustness score on record — while LaMem-VLA (dual latent memory, 97.6), HiMe (hierarchical embodied memory, real-world progress 90), LEEVLA (latent environment attention, 98.2 / CALVIN 4.34) and Harness-VLA (memory-guided frozen-VLA agent) attack long-horizon drift from complementary angles.

insights.title: Meta-World finally joins the scoreboard
insights.body: After tracking 300+ models with an empty Meta-World column, two entries landed in one week: Lift3D-VLA (PKU, 3D-lifted Prismatic + layer-wise diffusion) posts 87.7 alongside RLBench 82.8, and FabriVLA (lightweight InternVL3.5-1B + flow matching) reaches tier-avg 90.0. All eight tracked benchmarks now have data.

insights.title: Driving VLAs converge on hybrid decoding
insights.body: Three autonomous-driving entries arrived with distinct heads: AnchorVLA's AR anchor tokens + flow-matching residual takes Bench2Drive closed-loop SR to 77.28 (SOTA), WCog-VLA's InternVL3-2B + ADDT diffusion hits NAVSIM v1 PDMS 92.9, and PixelPilot (ECCV) decodes 2D pixel trajectories autoregressively. The AR-plans-flow-refines recipe is emerging as the driving default.
